create.name: Arjuna Ardagh
create.bio:
Arjuna Ardagh is a writer, speaker and coach who has spent much of his working life helping people notice the awakened awareness that is already present in everyday life. He founded Awakening Coaching, a training in which facilitators learn to guide clients through simple inquiry into who they really are, and over the years he has trained well over a thousand people in the method. His book The Translucent Revolution, published in 2005, described ordinary people living from that kind of awakening, and he has written several others, including Better Than Sex and, with John Gray, Conscious Men.

His later work, gathered under the name Radical Brilliance, looks at how original ideas arise and how a person can shape daily habits of practice, rest and creativity so that insight can flow. The book of the same name drew on interviews with hundreds of artists, scientists and inventors. He coaches individuals over three-month periods and, through his Radical Brilliance channel, now hosts long conversations on Taoist cultivation, relationship and inner practice. He lives in Nevada City, California, with his wife, the teacher Chameli Ardagh.

books.title: The Translucent Revolution: How People Just Like You Are Waking Up and Changing the World
books.author: Arjuna Ardagh
books.description: Drawing on many interviews, Ardagh describes people from ordinary walks of life who have glimpsed their true nature and kept living from it. He argues that such awakening is becoming widespread and looks at how it changes work, relationships and service.

books.title: Radical Brilliance: The Anatomy of How and Why People Have Original Life-Changing Ideas
books.author: Arjuna Ardagh
books.description: A study of where original ideas come from, built on conversations with artists, scientists and inventors. Ardagh sets out a cycle of creative phases and suggests daily practices and habits that help a person stay open to fresh insight.

courses.title: Radical Brilliance Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one coaching with Arjuna or a coach he has trained, usually agreed three months at a time. Sessions work on a creative or service project alongside a daily practice routine chosen for the client.
